enforcement.model: requirePermissions(required[], errorCode='FORBIDDEN'|'PERMISSION_DENIED') reads c.get('user').permissions (set by authMiddleware from DrizzleRoleRepository.findPermissionsForUser: user_roles -> role_permissions -> permissions, code = `${action}.${resource}`). Fail-closed; denials logged (AUTHZ_DENIED) never audited-to-DB; 401 if no user, 403 with generic message if missing perms.
enforcement.adminGate: apps/api/src/interfaces/http/middleware/auth.ts:38-41 — authMiddleware itself refuses (403 FORBIDDEN) any authenticated user whose resolved permission list is empty, so admin surfaces require at least one role-granted permission before requirePermissions runs.
